---
name: Ask the GitHub QA model
about: A 600K-parameter transformer that knows Jerry's public repos, run from a Markdown document
title: "qa: "
---

Put a question about Jerry's GitHub in the **title** after `qa:` (for example `qa: what is qwentpu`), then Submit. A bot runs the model from `mdrt/QA.md`, replies with the answer and an animation, and closes this issue. Questions outside Jerry's GitHub get a refusal. Leave this body as is.
